kind: real non-model Work, asynchronous inspection, and two-attempt isolation
stack: installPalimpsest → ProjectController → makeWorkDelegationService → dshSubprocessWorkWorkerPort, driven by a LOCAL NON-MODEL Node stub

stubSafety.onlyEffect: a file edit plus a git commit inside the attempt's own execution world

asynchronousInspection.measured: `start()` returned { state: 'STARTED' } before the job finished; the terminal phase was observed by polling `followup`
the Trajectory service addressed the attempt by its canonical id AFTER start() returned, with no reference to the host job handle and no active main Agent Turn

workerOutcomeIsNotSettlement.caveatPresent: a direct child exiting with code zero does not prove Work settlement, and a DSH turn/end does not prove promotion
workerOutcomeIsNotSettlement.measured: the Preview reports the process as EXITED while promotion remains NOT_PROMOTED — the two facts never collapse

noFabricatedSession.measured: the stub produces no DSH session; V0 reports SESSION_UNBOUND semantics explicitly rather than inventing an id

afterRestart.followupDetail: this host has no such job (host-local jobs are not durable, so a restart forgets them) — inspect the attempt by its own id for the canonical truth
afterRestart.measured: a NEW delegation service reported the old handle as UNKNOWN, and the Preview reported UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART while the canonical attempt and its result stayed independently readable and unchanged

twoAttemptIsolation.arrangement: two INDEPENDENT projects, both started before either was awaited, so their executions genuinely interleave — the ruling's permitted arrangement when the scheduler would refuse simultaneous attempts in one project

crossContamination.measured: each Preview's host/attempt identity matches only its own attempt, and each projection root differs

twoAttemptIsolation.interleavedTimingIsNotCausality: V0 derives no precedence from wall-clock interleaving; the two Previews share no edge and no ordering claim
twoAttemptIsolation.measured: a second build for attempt A produced the same previewDigest and the same viewId

negativeControls.control: supply B's SessionId as A's claimed binding (no reader composed)
negativeControls.outcome: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with sessionLifecycle SESSION_IDENTIFIED_NOT_READ — never a successful binding

negativeControls.control: a composed reader whose header names a DIFFERENT session
negativeControls.outcome: CONFLICT, and readEvents is never reached

negativeControls.control: the same display label (task_id 't1') on two different Attempts
negativeControls.outcome: distinct canonical ids, distinct view ids, neither view claims the other's attempt

negativeControls.control: a reader asserting trustedIngestion / RUN_ATTEMPT_CORRELATED / 'the attempt settled and was promoted'
negativeControls.outcome: the self-declared claim does not raise the binding above BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY and does not change the canonical promotion state

negativeControls.control: an unrelated event page from the Session reader
negativeControls.outcome: the page's own proves-list is never propagated into the Preview's canonical facts
